office.description: A workspace building focused on productivity, collaboration, and administrative tasks.

house.description: A residential dwelling designed for private living, family activities, and rest.

hospital.description: A healthcare facility providing medical treatment, patient care, and emergency services.

library.description: A public or academic building for reading, studying, and archiving physical and digital media.

school.description: An educational institution designed for teaching, learning, and student collaboration.

mall.description: A large commercial retail complex featuring multiple shops, food courts, and entertainment zones.

museum.description: A cultural institution dedicated to preserving and exhibiting artifacts of historical, scientific, or artistic significance.

warehouse.description: A large industrial facility used for storage, logistics, and goods distribution.

hotel.description: A commercial hospitality building providing lodging, dining, and guest services.

restaurant.description: A commercial establishment where meals and drinks are prepared and served to customers.
